<thought>To find the appropriate Still‑Gennari retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for templates that, when applied to the target molecule (the protected alkene C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CO)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO), form a C‑C double bond and a carboxylic ester. These are the functional groups listed in the database as “C‑C double bonds” and “carboxylic esters”. I will request up to 5 matching templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CO)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "carboxylic esters"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
